analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($217.44) vs SMA5/20/50 ($218.68/$219.03/$208.80): short-term weak, mid-term strong.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($209.21/$195.92): maintaining mid-to-long-term trend strength.

[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing resistance ($227.92) + potential challenge of 52-week high upon breakout.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.59x) + reduced conviction in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation) + entry condition: RSI stabilization above 50 and MACD golden cross confirmation.
